notes.title: Spooples is Out Now!
notes.content:
Hello all!

After being worked on for several months, Spooples is now available to play on Steam for free!  This is my first game published on Steam, and so far I am happy with how the game looks.  One day there will be updates for the game, but for now you can play as Spooples the Ghost and try to escape the underworld!  Donation DLC is available to purchase as well!

Thank you and have fun playing!

---Bill Frye
